test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given statements are followed by two conclusions. Find out which conclusion is true based on the given statements.

**Statements:**

J > K = L, M ge N Q > R

**Conclusions:**

I. P > M

II. N < P

options.text: Both conclusion I and II are true
Neither conclusion I nor II is true

solution:
**__Given__:**

J > K = L, M ge N Q > R

**__Conclusions__:**

I. P > M → False

We have P > J and J > K which means P > K

also M ge N 

II. N → True

We have P > J and J > K which means P > K also N 

when we combine both the relations we get, P > K > N so **P > N.**

So **only conclusion II is true.**

Hence, the correct answer is** Option 4.**
